2
Drop Extension into Google Chrome (10s)

To route your phone keystrokes directly into Google Meet, Zoom Web, Teams, & Demo Call chats, install the bundled Chrome extension:

  1. Open Google Chrome and navigate to chrome://extensions
  2. Turn ON the Developer mode toggle switch in the top-right corner.
  3. Drag and drop the folder named "Chrome Extension" from this DMG window right into your Chrome window!

3
Scan Pairing QR with Your Phone

Click the LazyType mascot in your Mac menu bar and choose Pair Phone. Scan the QR code with your phone camera (or open the local URL on the same Wi-Fi).
